title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past
file: Legend of Zelda, The - A Link to the Past (U) [!].smc
issues: Outdoors the side columns show the overworld as it really continues.
Indoors (houses, dungeons) the sides show the rest of the 512 x 512 map the room is drawn in: other rooms' walls and floors beside a small room.
Enemies appear near the SNES edge (the game creates them as they come near).

No flicker: in the 5,600 frames checked the game never drew more sprites on a line than a SNES shows (8 lines went over the SNES's limits with sprites that draw nothing there), so it changed nothing; it changes only lines over the limits.
Fast CPU ran the 5,600 frames checked; the game's timing changes.

verified.how: Workshop --wms-test (E6), 5,600 frames of a pad script (intro, name entry, Link's house, outside in the rain) in lockstep with the SNES console: widescreen's centre 256 columns identical to the SNES picture every frame, STAT77 and the sound identical, switched off frame-identical; no flicker changes only lines over the SNES's limits; better sound changes only the sound.
